verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting lets users visually define alert rules that are continuously evaluated and automatically send notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie. Grafana's on-call tooling can then escalate those alerts to whoever is on call, and community users confirm alert rules (even SQL-based ones) get routed automatically. Missing for 10: evidence that triggered actions go beyond notifications and escalation (e.g., arbitrary automated remediation or registrable outbound callbacks), documentation of rule-to-action configuration depth, and any AI-native rule authoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Visually define alert rules for your most important metrics. Grafana will continuously evaluate and send notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie.
escalate alerts to the people who are on call
The alert can be written in SQL and, with Grafana 8, routed just like Prometheus alerts.
